label: EU AI Act High-Risk System Compliance Mapping

legal_basis: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI), adopted 2026-07-08, in force 2026-07-27
applicability_dates_provenance.change_note: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 deferred only Chapter III Sections 1-3: to 2027-12-02 for Annex III systems and 2028-08-02 for Annex I systems. Article 6(5) is expressly excluded. Article 50 generally applies from 2026-08-02, while Article 111(4) gives providers of specified systems placed on the market before that date until 2026-12-02 to comply with Article 50(2). Incident reporting under Article 73 and CE marking/registration provisions outside Sections 1-3 are not assigned the deferred dates by this mapping.
